title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
The page is a short scratch computation with three parts.

(1) Left column: an index-2 inclusion of fundamental groups. Let F = pi_1(P^1 - {0,1,infty}) = <l_0, l_1, l_infty | l_infty l_1 l_0 = 1>. Let Lambda = pi_1(P^1 - {0,1/2,1,infty}), with loops lambda_0, lambda_{1/2}, lambda_1, lambda_infty around the four punctures. The rules lambda_0 -> l_0^{-1} l_1 l_0, lambda_{1/2} -> l_0^2, lambda_1 -> l_1, lambda_infty -> l_infty^2 are exactly what the degree-2 map f(z) = (1-2z)^2 induces on loops. This map is the quotient by the involution z -> 1-z. It is ramified over 0 at the point 1/2 and over infty at infty. It sends the two points 0 and 1 to 1, unramified, which is why lambda_0 becomes a conjugate of l_1.

Consistency check (mine, not on the page): lambda_infty lambda_1 lambda_{1/2} lambda_0 maps to l_infty^2 l_1 l_0 l_1 l_0. Using l_1 l_0 = l_infty^{-1}, this is 1. So the map respects the four-point relation.

The arrows (-> versus the barred |->) and the targets l_0, l_1, l_infty written after them suggest the bookkeeping 'puncture lambda_i lies over puncture l_j, with ramification index e'. The pairs are (0 over 1, e=1), (1/2 over 0, e=2), (1 over 1, e=1), (infty over infty, e=2).

(2) Right column: a second homomorphism. It sends l_0 -> epsilon_0, l_1 -> l_1, l_infty -> epsilon_infty. It is to be well defined, i.e. compatible with l_infty l_1 l_0 = 1, which requires epsilon_infty l_1 epsilon_0 = 1.

(3) Bottom: candidate values in a group generated by rho and sigma_infty, namely epsilon_0 = sigma_infty rho, l_1 = rho sigma_infty, epsilon_infty = rho^{-1} sigma_infty rho^{-1}. Here rho is presumably the order-3 cyclic symmetry of {0,1,infty} and sigma_infty the transposition fixing infty. These are the standard generators of the S_3 symmetry of the genus-0, 3-point Teichmüller groupoid, or of PSL_2(Z) = Z/2 * Z/3 containing Gamma(2) ~ F with index 6.

The middle line verifies the relation by cancellation, with several factors struck out and two underbraces. Context: the 'Teichmülleries' notes on the genus-0 Teichmüller groupoid, its S_3 symmetries, and the rho/sigma presentation that underlies the Lego / Esquisse picture.
errors: With the values as written, epsilon_infty l_1 epsilon_0 = rho^{-1} sigma_infty rho^{-1} . rho sigma_infty . sigma_infty rho = rho^{-1} sigma_infty^3 rho.

If sigma_infty^2 = 1, this equals rho^{-1} sigma_infty rho, not 1. The required relation epsilon_infty l_1 epsilon_0 = 1 therefore fails, unless further relations or conventions hold (e.g. groupoid paths rather than group elements, or a different composition order).

The page itself ends with '= rho^{-1} sigma_infty' after strikings, which suggests Grothendieck noticed the check did not close up. The computation looks abandoned or in need of correction rather than finished.

deep.surprise_reason: A routine scratch verification: an explicit loop map for a standard double cover plus a (seemingly failed) relation check in rho, sigma generators. No new result or connection beyond what the Teichmüller / GT literature contains.
transcription_corrections: The first-column arrows (-> versus barred |->) likely encode which puncture lies over which, with ramification index, rather than a homomorphism to the targets 1, l_0, l_1, l_infty.

The struck-out portion of the middle line is ambiguous in the image. It reads roughly 'rho^{-1} sigma_infty rho^{-1} rho sigma_infty rho sigma_infty sigma_infty rho = rho^{-1} sigma_infty', with strikes on the cancelled factors and underbraces under 'rho^{-1} sigma_infty rho^{-1}' and 'rho sigma_infty'.
The line 'l_1 = rho sigma_infty' starts with a corrected letter: it was overwritten, perhaps originally epsilon_1.
